prompts:
Create a high fidelity Chinese ERP desktop UI design mockup, 1920x1080 landscape. This is a new design based on reference image 1 only for visual style, not a copy of its data. Match the HiTree ERP screenshot: dark charcoal 230px sidebar, warm ivory #f5f3eb canvas, thin beige borders, burnt orange #ce4e27 primary buttons, restrained compact Chinese typography. No gradients or modern dashboard cards. Sharp legible Simplified Chinese text.
Show a NEW PAGE opened from 内部计划 / 金工计划, breadcrumb 生产车间 / 内部计划 / 半成品入库. Page title 半成品入库 with small badge 厂内入库 and right link 返回金工计划. Preserve similar sidebar with 生产车间 expanded and 内部计划 highlighted, but simplified nav labels.
Main white bordered section order info: 生产订单：演示订单-001  产品：折叠椅  工序：金工  订单数量：1000 把. Small amber text 示例数据 · 设计预览, not live records.
Second row editable fields 收货日期 2026-09-28 / 材料仓 半成品仓 / 库区 一楼 / 入库人 当前仓管(readonly).
Below title 本次入库明细, concise rule 累计入库不得超过 BOM 单个用量 × 订单数量.
A dense but clean table with EXACT 11 columns: 选择 | 部位 | 材质 / 规格 | 颜色 | 加工阶段 | 单位 | 单个用量 | 应入库 | 已入库 | 剩余可入 | 本次入库.
Three rows with consistent arithmetic: checked | 连接管 | 铁 / Ø16×0.8×350mm | 本色 | 金工完成 | 支 | 4 | 4000 | 1500 | 2500 | numeric input 500.
unchecked disabled | 支撑管 | 铁 / Ø18×0.8×420mm | 本色 | 金工完成 | 支 | 2 | 2000 | 2000 | 0 | disabled input and 已入足.
unchecked | 扶手管 | 铁 / Ø20×1.0×500mm | 本色 | 金工完成 | 支 | 2 | 2000 | 600 | 1400 | blank numeric input.
Show more subtle note 需外发喷塑的部件沿用原外发流程，不在此入库.
Remark textarea 备注 placeholder 填写本次收货说明.
Bottom fixed action bar: left 已选 1 项 · 本次入库 500 支. Right outlined 取消 button, orange 确认入库 button. Beneath or alongside concise 确认后立即增加库存.
No 审核, 待审核, 提交审批 buttons. No batch selection, cost or wage sections. All sample quantities are positive integers. Table fits without horizontal scroll. Spacious remaining page like reference. This is the metal variant; sewing reuses exact page structure with its actual fabric component attributes and 套 unit, do not put a pretend sewing-switch on the form. Deliver one polished full screen screenshot, no external notes, no split panels.

Create a high fidelity Chinese ERP desktop UI mockup, 1920x1080 landscape. New page based on reference image 2 as style guide. Match HiTree ERP: dark charcoal 230px left sidebar, warm ivory #f5f3eb canvas, thin beige table borders, burnt orange #ce4e27 buttons, compact legible Simplified Chinese. Keep dense working tables, no decorative cards or gradients. Sidebar 仓库管理 expanded, 材料库存 highlighted.
Design page 半成品入库记录 with breadcrumb 仓库管理 / 材料库存 / 半成品入库记录 and small label 示例数据 · 设计预览. Link 返回半成品库存 at top right. Not a new primary sidebar item.
Filters across top: text input 搜索入库单号、订单、产品、部位; source segmented 全部 | 厂内入库 | 外发入库 selected 全部; date input 入库日期; 查询 orange and 重置 white.
Main area left about 1100px wide table and right about 500px detail panel. Table title 入库明细. EXACT columns 入库单号 | 入库来源 | 订单 / 产品 | 部位 | 数量 | 单位 | 入库日期 | 状态 | 操作. Three rows:
RK-DEMO-003 | 厂内入库 subdued orange tag | 演示订单-001 / 折叠椅 | 连接管 | 500 | 支 | 2026-09-28 | 已入库 green | 查看.
RK-DEMO-002 | 外发入库 subdued blue tag | 演示订单-002 / 折叠椅 | 前脚管 | 800 | 支 | 2026-09-28 | 已入库 green | 查看.
RK-DEMO-001 | 厂内入库 subdued orange tag | 演示订单-001 / 折叠椅 | 座布 | 300 | 套 | 2026-09-28 | 已入库 green | 查看.
Select first row subtly warm highlight; detail panel header 入库详情 with × close. Number RK-DEMO-003. Definition list 来源 厂内入库; 来源计划 PC-DEMO-001 clickable; 工序 金工; 订单 演示订单-001; 产品 折叠椅; 部位 连接管; 材质规格 铁 / Ø16×0.8×350mm; 颜色 本色; 加工阶段 金工完成; 本次入库 500 支; 收货日期 2026-09-28; 仓库 / 库区 半成品仓 / 一楼; 入库人 当前仓管; 备注 分批收货.
Below panel short labeled section 本次入库时的数量 showing 应入库 4000 支; 入库前已入 1500 支; 入库后已入 2000 支; 当时剩余 2000 支. Historical snapshot, not current stock.
Below table understated text 同属性、同工艺阶段的半成品共用库存，来源保留在入库记录中. Pagination 共3条 50条/页 1.
No approve, reject, edit, delete, export or extra actions. No 待审核. External record detail when opened would show external order and processor instead of internal plan, but current selected record is internal. Do not invent a shared grand total summing 支 and 套. Present one professional full page screenshot.

Keep EVERY OTHER element, text, number, font, color, layout, table row, sidebar, footer and image size unchanged. Do not redraw or simplify any text. Keep 已选1项 and 本次入库500支 unchanged.
